messages:
Olivia: Very small personal update 11 1 — Ben asked me to marry him last night! We said yes :sparkling_heart: Wanted to share here because you all have been such great humans.
Ben: She said yes!! Thank you for all the love. Also I promise to bring coffee to dev standups forever.
Harper: OMG CONGRATS!! 389 389 Can we get a tiny engagement celebration tomorrow in the SF kitchen? I will bring confetti (paper only).
Maya: Huge congrats Olivia and Ben!! :tada: We should do a mini-card and cake. PeopleOps can we order a small cake for tomorrow at 3pm?
PeopleOps: Congrats!! We can approve a small celebratory cake and a $50 gift card. Please submit a quick form by noon.
CateringBot: Catering request accepted: "Engagement - Olivia & Ben" Drop-off 2:45pm. Back fridge available for storage.
Olivia: You all are too sweet 60a If we do cake, can remote folks get a virtual cheers? Maybe send a photo and zoom link?
Ben: Zoom link would be great. Also low-key: please don't make Ben give a speech.
Harper: No speeches. Maybe one awkward toast max. Also I will make a tiny card for folks to sign in the kitchen. Bring a Sharpie.
Maya: I'll bring Sharpie + my terrible photographer skills for the photo. Remote folks, drop a GIF here and we'll include it in the collage.
OpsBot: Reminder: Decorations allowed only on the community table. Please clear all items by 5pm for cleaning. No glitter.
Olivia: Noted. Also for those voting on time: react with :one: for 3pm, :two: for 4pm.
Harper: :one: works for me.
Maya: :one:
PeopleOps: :one: confirmed. We'll finalize order.
Ben: Thank you team. Also please hold any embarrassing stories until after the cake (or forever).
Olivia: We'll save two slices for remote teammates where possible. Thank you all for being the best. 
Harper: Congrats again!! Sending all the confetti and a tiny virtual champagne emoji :champagne: (non-alcoholic for office).
Maya: Photo ops at 3:15. See you there and congrats to you both 970
